item.title: KALDVIK AS (KLDVK): Jellyfish event in Reyðarfjörður
item.description: Kaldvik AS reports a jellyfish event affecting sea pens in Reyðarfjörður. The company is assessing biological impact and expects to provide an updated harvest volume guidance.

item.title: Zhihu Inc. Announces Proposed Subscription in AI-Focused Investment Fund
item.description: Zhihu Inc. (NYSE: ZH) announced today that it has entered into a subscription agreement to invest in an artificial-intelligence-focused investment fund. The proposed subscription is subject to customary closing conditions.

item.title: Roivant to Present Topline Results from the Phase 2 PHocus Study of Mosliciguat in Patients with Pulmonary Hypertension Associated with Interstitial Lung Disease (PH-ILD) at the ERS Congress
item.description: Roivant Sciences (NASDAQ: ROIV) will present topline results from the Phase 2 PHocus study of mosliciguat in patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease at the European Respiratory Society Congress.

item.title: Verizon Waives Charges for Hurricane Lowell, Prepares Network in Hawai'i
item.description: Verizon (NYSE: VZ) is waiving call, text and data charges for customers in affected areas of Hawai'i and has pre-positioned portable network assets ahead of Hurricane Lowell.
